legalTransitions.when: any approved payload, brief, manifest, mode, version, or digest changes
any required automated validator or selected-output visual validator blocks

PASS: fact, structure, and contract validators all PASS
every requested output automation status is PASS
every requested output visual status is PASS
BLOCK: any requested output NOT_REVIEWED or BLOCK
any unresolved OCR assignment, ambiguity, low confidence, or missing toolchain
STALE_APPROVAL: approval revision or any approved digest does not match evidence

rerunPolicy.firstBlock: modify, create a current approval revision, then rerun all three validators once
rerunPolicy.secondBlock: reject cycle or start a separately approved new cycle
